title: Catalyst
text: “That’s right. Tiger Guy is physically a demi-human, but spiritually closer to a regular person, whereas Tiger Girl’s heart is more demi-human, or so I hear, I say.”
By that logic, wouldn’t Tiger Girl be the one susceptible to Father’s charms… turning into a tiger-girl version of the first world’s her?
“Even hearing that Naofumi-sama’s appearance has changed, I can only make out an outline, so…”
“I see, so it’s precisely because you can’t see that you’re unaffected by his change in appearance.”
“Why must you analyze such things…”
“I’ve always been curious about Naofumi-sama, but if I press too far it’ll only be a bother, so I’ll take my leave here.”
You mustn’t back down here! I feel like the first world’s Tiger Girl was protesting somewhere inside her, but Tiger Girl simply bowed and walked away, I say.
“So… any progress?”
“Rafuemon-san went out looking for Gaelion-san, and Rishia-san is investigating the catalyst used in the spell. Motoyasu-san’s saying he doesn’t want Naofumi-san meeting Gaelion-san.”
“Judging by how Sadeena and the others are acting, it might be true that the people closest to us are the most dangerous.”
“Ren too. If it comes out that you swapped places with Luna-chan, won’t she come chasing after you?”
Eeeeeek… if Ren’s with us, does that mean that Luna-chan is coming?
“Ren, be a sacrifice for a while until Luna-chan’s hunger is satisfied, I say.”
“Don’t mess with me, Motoyasu! If anything, you go instead! You like Filolials, so you’ll be fine!”
“Eeeeeek!”
“Motoyasu-kun’s screaming, which is rare… guess it’s true he’s bad with unhinged girls…”
“I suppose it’s even more emphasized when it’s an unhinged Filolial.”
That Luna-chan carries the same air as that Filo-tan from back then, so I can’t handle her, I say. Whatever shall I do?
“For now, if Gaelion-san comes, I’ll handle it. I’m not sure Motoyasu-san can properly communicate with Gaelion-san.”
As we were talking like this, a voice came from outside, I say.
“Nano, Gaelion heard that Naofumi and the others turned into pioneer creatures and can’t change back, nano.”
“Yeah.”
At this, Itsuki raised his hand and went out of the house, I say.
“Ah, Gaelion-san. Sadeena-san and the others saw Naofumi-san lose himself, so if you see Naofumi-san there’s a chance you might carry him off somewhere. So let me explain the situation.”
“That voice, is that the Bow Hero, nano? Quite a strange state you’re in, nano. Anyway, understood, nano.”
As Itsuki was talking like this, Assistant came into the house. And Assistant stared intently at us, I say.
“Charm effect on the Shield Hero…?”
Assistant tilted her head looking at Father, I say.
“Guess it doesn’t work on Wyndia-chan?”
“Probably?”
“Not sure how much to trust that. So, Wyndia-san. Do you know anything about this?”
“I don’t, but let me investigate a bit.”
Assistant proceeded to examine us by touch, I say.
“Like a monster… but also not quite…? The magic cast on you is… hmm…”
Having finished her examination, Assistant went back to Rival, I say. In her place, Itsuki came back into the house.
“I had Gaelion-san investigate with magic, but the story is she couldn’t figure it out.”
“Useless, I say!”
A dragon that’s useless when it actually matters, I say.
“Still, she said it’s probably some official type of magic used by heroes, and that the catalyst was suspicious, so she’s heading to Rishia-san’s place.”
With that, the village steadily began to stir with commotion, I say. Not long after that, Riska came bearing the catalyst. Itsuki and I ended up going out of the house to talk about it, I say.
“Spear Hero… nano, you’ve become quite the cute little thing, nano.”
The moment Rival saw me, she covered her mouth and spoke mockingly, I say.
“Silence, I say! Shall Gaelion have a taste of Brionac! In the first place, what’s the meaning of all that competence you always flaunt when you can’t even solve this, I say!”
“Nano, when Gaelion tried casting a spell to turn the Bow Hero back into human form, it got repelled by the legendary weapon’s defense function, nano.”
“So it means the weapon approved of the spell, but why did this even happen…”
“Anyway, from a bit of investigating, nano, it turns out this catalyst was a gift from the Four Heroes Church, nano.”
“Yes. It seems to be a fine piece that was left behind at the church, originally sent to the heroes.”
Riska said this with the storehouse’s inventory ledger in hand, I say.
“When Gaelion investigated deeply with magic, nano, it turned out the magic power used matches that of hero characters, which only heroes can handle, nano.”
“So it’s a relic from the past, I suppose… come to think of it, this catalyst…”
Itsuki stared intently at the catalyst. Hm…? For some reason, I feel like I’ve seen it too, I say.
“Luna-san hasn’t come yet. Ren-san, could you come here for a moment?”
“What is it?”

Ren, called over, came out of the house, I say. Oh? Inside the house, Mole was doing some sewing, I say. In order to solve Luna-chan’s hunger problem, she was making a stuffed doll modeled after Ren. Since Mole was indeed the one who made Keel’s stuffed doll, this might be a good method, I say. I’ll help too, I say.
“Are you two alright?”
“Yes. Somehow… managing to stay calm.”
“Yeah. Hero-sama, cute.”
“If we make stuffed dolls and sell them, they’d probably be popular.”
“Imiya-chan…”
They seem to be getting along well, I say.
“Ah… nano, it’s just like Keel, nano. I see, nano. The Inult costume with a different pattern becomes Keel, nano.”
Rival nodded as if convinced by Ren’s appearance, I say.
“Who’s Keel anyway. Feels like I’ve heard the name before.”
“Someone who’s supposed to be in this village, nano. But in this loop, we can’t find them, nano.”
At Rival’s answer, Ren fell silent, I say. Indeed, no matter how much we search, Keel can’t be found… in other loops she’s found right away, but not this time, I say.
“Getting back on topic, the spell humans use called Polymorph should be an unstable magic that gets undone by the passage of time, by dispel magic, or even just by engaging in combat, nano.”
“So does that mean if we fight or exercise, the spell will break too?”
At Itsuki’s question, Rival shook her head, I say.
“But the magic currently cast on the heroes is extremely stable, nano.”
“This is troubling. ‘All the heroes turned into pioneer creatures’—what kind of joke is that!”
“That’s why Gaelion and the others are investigating, nano… hmm.”
Rival and Riska were examining the equipment used in the catalyst, I say.
“Ren-san. Do you have no memory of this catalyst? I couldn’t place it right away either, but apparently Motoyasu-san has some memory of it.”
“Hm?”
“Nano, does he know something, nano?”
“Let me borrow this for a moment. Let’s have Naofumi-san confirm it too, the other way around.”
Itsuki took the tool that had become the catalyst from Rival and Riska and went over to Father, I say.
“Ah, are the three of you done talking?”
“No, by the way, Naofumi-san. You have no memory of this tool until we started using it, right?”
“Huh? Well… I just think ‘oh, so there’s a catalyst like this,’ I don’t really have any specific memory of it, do I?”
At Father’s answer, Itsuki said “as I thought,” I say. Hmm… I too feel like I’ve seen something like this, but I can’t recall what it is, I say.
“Probably it was an item used for a purpose other than its original one, since it was convenient as a magical catalyst, I’d guess.”
“Itsuki, what is it? If you know, don’t be coy about it, just tell us, would you?”
“Indeed, I say.”
Father has no memory of it, while Ren and I seem to, going by this conversation, I say. …Oh? This setup, I have a feeling I recognize it, I say.
“Could this perhaps be about the time we played that game, I say?”
“Motoyasu-san noticed too, huh. Yes… it was an event item, but I finally managed to remember it myself.”
“Hmm?”
Ren, staring intently at the catalyst in Itsuki’s hand, began nodding as if he’d just remembered something, I say.
“Ahhhhh! I got it, Itsuki!”
